summary: The figure presents two stacked bar charts showing excess deaths and years of life lost due to the COVID-19 pandemic by age group and WHO region for 2020–2021. Excess deaths increase with age, peaking in the 65–74 age group, with the South-East Asia Region contributing the largest share across most age groups. Years of life lost also peak in middle age groups (55–64 and 65–74), with the South-East Asia Region again showing the highest values. The Western Pacific Region shows some negative values in younger age groups, indicating fewer deaths than expected.
